identity: Raincall Basin lives by the rains, and Vek's bandits have started selling them back as a tithe.

quests.title: What the Garden Gives
quests.text: Our gardeners coax a harvest through the rain, and then Vek's collectors arrive to claim credit for the weather. Bring me four Melons for the people doing the growing. I have yet to see a collector pull a single weed.
quests.lesson: The zone's first errand, a level only; the early potion choice.
quests.notes: Round 59 BANDQUESTS: free play, a level only.

quests.title: Footprints Between Gardens
quests.text: Vek's collectors use the paths our gardeners keep open, then charge those same households for the rain. Speak to Neshi Reedstep at Raincall Outpost and tell her what is happening here. She follows their footsteps; I want her to know what each stop costs us.
quests.lesson: A local task of the zone's own people (draft K15).
quests.notes: Round 59 BANDQUESTS: free play, a level only.

quests.title: Warmth After the Watch
quests.text: By the time my watchers come in, the rain has found every gap in their clothes. Bring me five Sunleaf for something hot when they return. I cannot promise a dry watch, but I can give them a reason to hurry home.
quests.lesson: A local task of the zone's own people (draft K15).
quests.notes: Round 59 BANDQUESTS: free play, a level only.

quests.title: The Dry Way Home
quests.text: I hang the clothes above the water, then watch their owners get soaked climbing into the houses. Bring me ten Wooden Ladders for the stilts. Dry laundry should stay dry at least until someone puts it on.
quests.lesson: A local task of the zone's own people (draft K15).
quests.notes: Round 59 BANDQUESTS: free play, a level only.

quests.title: More Than One Hunter
quests.text: Servals stalk the paths my watchers use to follow the collectors. Hunt eight by day in the {name:cloudwood}, which lies {zone_area:cloudwood}. I would like my people to be the ones doing the following for a change.
quests.lesson: A day hunt; the first armor choice (one enchant, a prefix).
quests.notes: Round 59 BANDQUESTS: free play, a level only.

quests.title: Keep a Little Back
quests.text: Rain gets into a loose bundle, and the collectors get into anything that opens easily. Bring me two Locked Chests for our household stores. I mean to keep something dry and useful ready for the people who come home to it.
quests.lesson: A craft from Basic recipes; the second armor choice (one enchant, a suffix).
quests.notes: Round 59 BANDQUESTS: free play, a level only.

quests.title: Veko Promised Nothing
quests.text: Veko Bluefeather refused a rain tithe nobody here had promised, and the collectors put him in the {name:bandit_camp}, {dir_from_giver:bandit_camp}. Go and hear his account. The families who paid had threats at their doors too; Veko's refusal deserves to be heard without making their fear a fault.
quests.lesson: A local task of the zone's own people (draft K15).
quests.notes: Round 59 BANDQUESTS: free play, a level only.

quests.title: No Rain for {name:tithe_keeper_vek}
quests.text: Bandit Tithe-Keeper Vek claims he can sell us the rain, though I have never seen him wring out a cloud. Kill him here in the {name:bandit_camp} and come back to me. He calls what he takes a promised tithe; I know what we promised, and it was nothing.
quests.completion: Vek is down, and the rain has somehow managed to keep falling. My neighbours paid because they were threatened; let them hear that the threat is gone, with no shame attached to how they endured it.
quests.lesson: The named perpetrator at his place; the weapon choice (prefix and suffix).
quests.notes: Round 59 BANDQUESTS: free play, a level only.

quests.title: No Promise, No Tithe
quests.text: Take my words to Nalo Pathdrum in Kezamba: Veko Bluefeather never promised Vek a rain tithe, and neither did the households he collected from. I refused him; others paid with threats at their doors. Let Nalo hear both parts before anyone calls that payment an agreement.
quests.notes: Round 59 BANDQUESTS: the departure id stays; free from 19, it requires nothing and claims no earlier deed (draft §1, §2).
